title: Otis and the Glowing Plum
markdown:
Otis the duck loved mornings. He loved the way the soft, warm sunshine gently warmed his little bill, and the cheerful quacks of his friends as they softly stirred from their slumber. But most of all, Otis loved waiting for the very first plum of the season to glow. This was a special plum, you see, and when it glowed, it meant it was perfectly ripe and ready for tasting! He waddled, with his characteristic happy wobble, over to the old plum tree, the home of Plum, the little plum-tree pixie. Plum was always very busy, and today she was carefully polishing her shimmering wings until they sparkled like captured moonlight.

"Hello there, my dear Otis!" giggled Plum, her voice like tiny bells chiming. She sprinkled a little puff of petal dust from a nearby blossom onto her nose, which always made her sneeze a very musical sound. "Are you all ready to watch for the Wonderful, the Magical, the Very First Plum?"

Otis bounced his fluffy, honey-colored tail feathers with quiet delight. "Oh, yes, Plum! I don't think I've ever been more ready in my whole life!"

And so, they settled themselves down together at the very base of the tall plum tree, their eyes wide and hopeful, gazing up, up, up into the leafy branches. The plum tree was dotted with many little green plums, still growing and waiting, but Otis and Plum were patiently anticipating the one special plum. The plum that would softly glow with a warm light, whispering a quiet message to everyone who could see: "I am perfectly ripe and ready to be tasted!" It felt like waiting for a beautiful secret to be shared by the gentle afternoon sun.

Then, with a tiny, soft movement, a little plum on the very highest branch began to shimmer. It wasn't just any shimmer, oh no! It glowed with a soft, golden light, a light as warm and comforting as a little sleepy sunbeam that had decided to linger. Otis let out a happy little quack, a sound of quiet joy. "Look, Plum! Look! It's glowing! It's really glowing!"

And then, so gently, the glowing plum gave a little sway, and then, as softly as a whisper, it lifted away from its stem. It didn't fall down to the ground, oh no, not at all! Instead, it floated away, as gracefully as a tiny, glowing balloon on a whisper of a breeze.

"Oh my!" exclaimed Otis, his eyes wide with wonder. "It's floating away."

Plum fluttered her dewdropped wings in surprise. "My goodness! It's never, ever done that before! Let's follow it."

Otis looked thoughtfully at the little stream that meandered so peacefully past the plum tree. "But, Plum," he pondered with a slight tilt of his head, "how will we ever follow a plum that's floating away on its own?"

Plum, her eyes twinkling with a gentle idea, pointed to a large, fallen leaf that lay near the water's edge. It looked just right. "Why, we'll make a boat!" she said softly.

With a gentle nudging from Otis and careful guidance from Plum, the leaf eased into the stream. Otis settled himself gently onto the leaf, his wobbly duck legs finding their balance on the leafy surface. Plum perched daintily on the very edge, her tiny feet barely making a ripple in the water. The leaf boat began to bob softly, a gentle little vessel ready for its journey.

"Welcome aboard our little leaf boat," said Plum softly. "Our gentle journey to the glowing plum!"

The stream flowed like a ribbon of liquid moonlight, unhurred and ever so slow. Otis gently moved his webbed feet, helping their leaf drift along, while Plum, with a tiny twig, softly guided them. They drifted past tall, slender reeds that seemed to whisper secrets to the soft, passing breeze, and they watched as little silvery fish peeked out shyly from beneath smooth, rounded stones. And there, just ahead of them, they could still see the glowing plum, bobbing on the water, leading them gently onward. It felt like a special discovery.

After a little while, the narrow stream gently widened into a calm, still pool, like a shimmering mirror reflecting the sky. The glowing plum, perhaps a little tired from its floaty travels, settled itself down very gently onto a soft, verdant patch of moss right by the water's edge. It looked so wonderfully peaceful there, still glowing with that lovely, soft light, as if it had found the perfect place to rest.

Otis and Plum gently guided their leaf boat to the mossy bank, settling it softly ashore. Plum gracefully moved to the bank and, with the most tender of touches, she carefully picked up the plum. It felt warm and smooth in her tiny hands, radiating a gentle warmth. It had been a wonderfully gentle journey, full of lovely discoveries.

"It's absolutely perfect," whispered Plum, her eyes sparkling with gentle wonder. She then offered the warm, glowing plum to Otis. "After you, my very best friend."

Otis leaned in and took a sweet, soft bite. *Mmmmmm.* Oh, the plum was so sweet and wonderfully smooth! It tasted like pure sunshine mixed with the happiest thoughts imaginable. It was, without a doubt, the most delicious plum he had ever tasted. Plum took a bite too, and they both closed their eyes for a moment, savoring the incredibly wonderful flavor that filled their senses.

As the sun began its slow descent towards the horizon, painting the sky in the most beautiful, soft shades of pink, lavender, and warm orange, Otis and Plum knew it was time to head home. They gently guided their little leaf boat back along the gentle, flowing stream, the sweet taste of the plum still lingering like a soft memory.

When they finally reached the familiar, welcoming plum tree, Otis gave Plum a gentle, affectionate nuzzle with his soft beak. "Thank you for the most wonderful, gentle journey, my dear Plum."

"Oh, thank *you*, Otis," chirped Plum happily, fluttering her wings a little sleepily. "That was truly the bestest, glowiest plum journey I could have ever imagined!"

Otis waddled back to his own cozy nest, nestled amongst the soft reeds by the water's edge. He snuggled down into his comfy bed, feeling safe and warm. The big, round moon was beginning to peek out from behind a fluffy cloud, casting a gentle, silvery glow on everything around them. Otis thought about the magical glowing plum, the delightful leaf boat, and his wonderful friend, Plum. It had been a very special day, a truly gentle day, a perfect day, from beginning to end. And soon, just like the little glowing plum had found its own peaceful resting place by the water, Otis drifted off into a deep, peaceful sleep, his dreams filled with sweet plums, quiet streams, and the happy smiles of his friends.
characters: Otis the duck, Plum the plum-tree pixie
